ambiguities.text: The specification does not define the format or encoding of the 'data' field in signing requests.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'data' is the raw bytes to be signed, encoded as a hexadecimal string.

ambiguities.text: The 'fork' parameter object structure is mentioned but not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'fork' follows the Ethereum 2.0 fork structure with epoch and version fields.

ambiguities.text: No specification of timeout or maximum response time for signing operations.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations should complete signing within reasonable HTTP timeout bounds; clients should implement their own timeouts.

ambiguities.text: The specification states operators must add 'validation modules' for slashing prevention but does not define what validation is required.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume validation includes checking for duplicate attestations and conflicting block proposals at minimum.

implicit_assumptions.description: The validator client requesting signatures is trusted and authorized to sign for the requested key.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unauthorized clients could request signatures, leading to unauthorized operations or slashing.

implicit_assumptions.description: The network between validator client and signer is secure (TLS) and not subject to man-in-the-middle attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could intercept or modify signing requests/responses, potentially causing slashing.

implicit_assumptions.description: Operators implement slashing protection external to this API specification.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without slashing protection, signing duplicate or conflicting messages could cause validator slashing.

implicit_assumptions.description: Physical access to the signer node is restricted, preventing memory dump attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers with physical access could extract private keys from memory.

implicit_assumptions.description: The HSM or secrets manager storing keys is properly configured and secure.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised key storage leads to complete loss of validator key security.
